Mapping(string => uint) counting mints per wallet keyed by address+version.
Mapping(uint => uint) cache used by the random mint strategy to swap used indexes with the tail.
Current total supply of tokens; incremented on mint and decremented on burn.
Counter of tokens minted so far.
Counter of tokens burned so far.
Flag enabling or disabling the burn function.
Address of the external GuestlistedArtProxy contract used to render token art.
Mapping(uint => CustomAttribute[]) of extra JSON attributes per token.
Mapping(uint => CustomMetadata[]) of extra JSON metadata per token.
Mapping(string => uint) declaring whether a background color needs white text.
Array of Venue structs (name, location, index ranges, colors, dj indexes).
Array of DJ structs (first name, last name, font size).
Caller address; used for whitelist signature recovery, holder check, per-wallet accounting and burn ownership.
Block timestamp used as part of the pseudo-random seed in random().
Payable nonReentrant mint entry point: validates config, optional whitelist/holder checks, per-wallet limit, then mints via random or predictable strategy.
External burn of a token owned by the caller; decrements totalSupply and increments burned.
onlyOwner function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
View returning base64-encoded JSON metadata including attributes, custom metadata and proxied art.
Internal function deriving a pseudo-random token index from sender address and updating mintCache/remaining.
Internal view producing a pseudo-random uint from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and an input string.
Private view assembling the TokenData struct (venue, dj, date, colors, shape, rarity numbers).
Internal pure keccak256-based deterministic number for a string input.
Internal pure deriving a formatted date string from a tokenId.
onlyOwner function updating or appending a venue in storage.
onlyOwner function updating or appending a DJ in storage.
onlyOwner function setting the white-text flag for a background color.
onlyOwner function updating the art proxy contract address.
onlyOwner function updating the address used to sign whitelists.
onlyOwner function replacing custom metadata for a list of token IDs.
onlyOwner function replacing custom attributes for a list of token IDs.
onlyOwner function overwriting the whole MintConfig struct.
onlyOwner function toggling isBurnActive.
onlyOwner function toggling mintConfig.isActive.
View enumerating token IDs owned by an address by scanning existing tokens.
Ownable accessor returning the current owner used by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership.
onlyOwner function renouncing contract ownership.
View returning the number of mints recorded for an address and version.
View returning the base64 SVG image of a token from the art proxy.
View returning a venue struct at a given index.
View returning a DJ struct at a given index.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) sending the full contract balance to the owner.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract during minting, an external callback into untrusted code.
Signature recovery via toEthSignedMessageHash().recover() used for whitelist verification in mint.
External call to artProxyContract.draw() during tokenURI/tokenImage execution.
Number of tokens requested in mint; bounds the mint loop.
Whitelist signature supplied to mint and verified via ECDSA recovery.
Token ID passed to burn.
Token ID passed to tokenURI for metadata generation.
Caller address passed into getRandomTokenIndex and hashed for randomness.
String input mixed into the random() seed.
Venue index passed to updateVenue (-1 means append).
New MintConfig struct passed to updateMintConfig.
Address whose owned tokens are enumerated in tokensOfOwner.
String key built from msg.sender and mintConfig.version for mintedPerWallet.
Pseudo-random number derived from the sender address inside getRandomTokenIndex.
Resolved token index returned by getRandomTokenIndex after cache lookup.
Contract ETH balance stored before being transferred in withdraw.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used for whitelist recovery, holder check and per-wallet mint accounting inside mint.
burn requires ownerOf(tokenId) == _msgSender to authorize the burn.
The caller address is passed as senderAddress into getRandomTokenIndex.
The withdrawal recipient is msg.sender, transferring value to an untrusted address.
mint reads isActive, price, remaining, limits and strategy flags from mintConfig.
mint reads and increments mintedPerWallet for the minter key.
mint writes mintCache in the predictable mint strategy.
mint increments totalSupply for each minted token.
mint increments the minted counter for each minted token.
mint calls getRandomTokenIndex when the random strategy is active.
_safeMint performs an external onERC721Received callback before mint state is fully settled.
mint performs ECDSA signature recovery to authorize whitelisted minters.
_nbTokens is validated and used to bound the mint loop.
The supplied signature is recovered and compared with mintConfig.whitelistSigner.
mint builds minterKey from msg.sender and mintConfig.version.
minterKey is used as the lookup key into the mintedPerWallet mapping.
getRandomTokenIndex calls random() to obtain a pseudo-random number.
getRandomTokenIndex uses mintConfig.remaining and startIndex to compute the index.
getRandomTokenIndex reads and writes mintCache to swap used indexes with the tail.
senderAddress is the input hashed into the random seed for index selection.
getRandomTokenIndex stores the pseudo-random number in randomNumber.
getRandomTokenIndex resolves the final index into the index local variable.
random() derives its result from block.timestamp, making it miner-influenceable.
The input string is packed with block.timestamp and block.difficulty in random().
burn requires isBurnActive to be true.
burn decrements totalSupply.
burn increments the burned counter.
_tokenId selects which token is burned.
withdraw forwards the full balance via a value transfer to msg.sender.
withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which calls owner().
withdraw caches address(this).balance into the balance local variable.
tokenURI calls getTokenData to build the token metadata.
tokenURI uses artProxyContract to obtain the token image.
tokenURI iterates customAttributes to append extra JSON attributes.
tokenURI iterates customMetadata to append extra JSON fields.
tokenURI invokes artProxyContract.draw() as an external call.
_tokenId is used to check existence and to build the metadata JSON.
getTokenData calls deterministic() for the deterministic and shape numbers.
getTokenData calls random() for the random number.
getTokenData calls getDate() to compute the token date.
getTokenData scans venues to select the venue matching the token ID.
getTokenData indexes djs using the venue dj indexes.
getTokenData reads isTextColorWhite to pick the text color.
getDate calls deterministic() on the token ID.
updateVenue pushes or overwrites an entry in the venues array.
updateVenue is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_index selects whether a venue is appended or updated in place.
updateDJ pushes or overwrites an entry in the djs array.
updateDJ is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateIsTextColorWhite writes the isTextColorWhite mapping.
updateIsTextColorWhite is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateArtProxyContract overwrites the artProxyContract state variable.
updateArtProxyContract is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateWhitelistSigner writes mintConfig.whitelistSigner.
updateWhitelistSigner is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateCustomMetadata deletes and rewrites customMetadata entries.
updateCustomMetadata is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateCustomAttributes deletes and rewrites customAttributes entries.
updateCustomAttributes is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateMintConfig overwrites the whole mintConfig struct.
updateMintConfig is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_mintConfig is the new configuration assigned in updateMintConfig.
flipBurnState negates the isBurnActive flag.
flipBurnState is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipMintState negates mintConfig.isActive.
flipMintState is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
tokensOfOwner enumerates tokens owned by _ownerAddress.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
getMintedPerWallet reads the mintedPerWallet mapping using an address+version key.
tokenImage calls getTokenData to feed the art proxy.
tokenImage performs an external artProxyContract.draw() call.
getVenueByIndex reads the venues array.
getDJByIndex reads the djs array.
